events.name: BayPort Credit Union Holiday Trail of Lights
events.info: Event series presented by Huffman & Huffman Brothers-In-Law The show is designed to be able to walk it from both directions. You can enter from both the North and the South entrances. There are 700 parking spaces in the North lot (main entrance) and 200 spaces in the South lot (Marsh Pavilion entrance). Is the path ADA accessible? Yes, the path is flat and wheelchair accessible. The aquarium also has wheelchairs available to rent upon request. What can I bring? You may bring a stroller, wheelchair, mobility scooter, outside food/drink, bags, etc. Bags may be subject to search upon entry. What can I not bring? You may not bring weapons of any kind, glass containers, outside alcohol, chairs, pets, vehicles of any kind (bikes, e-bikes, skateboards, scooters, etc.) or professional camera/video equipment. Will there be refunds/Can I exchange my ticket date? All sales are final and valid only for your day and time of purchase. No refunds or exchanges.
events.pleaseNote: Kids Pricing valid on ages 3-12. Kids 2 and under free with paid Adult admission.

events.name: Ballet Virginia : The Nutcracker
events.info: Experience the magic and enchantment of The Nutcracker as Ballet Virginia brings this beloved holiday classic to life on stage! Featuring a cast of over 100 dancers and the talents of Ballet Virginia?s professional company. This dazzling production will be accompanied by the live, sweeping sounds of Tchaikovsky?s iconic score performed by Symphonicity Orchestra. From waltzing flowers to playful mice and the delightful Sugar Plum Fairy, it?s a heartwarming celebration that promises lasting memories and joyful holiday spirit.
